comment: Functional stability is treated as a defining characteristic, but national health infrastructure must evolve with clinical guidance, law, technology, and health-system needs. Stability should apply to contracts and purpose, not to functionality remaining unchanged.

public.text: Functional stability is treated as a defining characteristic, but national health infrastructure must evolve with clinical guidance, law, technology, and health-system needs. Stability should apply to contracts and purpose, not to functionality remaining unchanged.
public.suggestedRevision: Define stability as predictable evolution: stable purpose, governed interfaces, semantic versioning, backward compatibility where appropriate, published migration paths, and controlled deprecation.
